description: This file contains unit tests for the ElevenLabsTTSClient class within the OpenClawKit project. It tests validation methods for output format, language, and normalization settings.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTTSValidationTests
classes.description: A test case class for testing validation methods of ElevenLabsTTSClient.

methods.name: testValidatedOutputFormatAllowsOnlyMp3Presets
methods.description: Tests that the output format validation accepts specific mp3 presets.

methods.name: testValidatedLanguageAcceptsTwoLetterCodes
methods.description: Tests that language validation accepts two-letter language codes and rejects longer strings.

methods.name: testValidatedNormalizeAcceptsKnownValues
methods.description: Tests that normalization validation accepts known values such as 'AUTO' and rejects unknown ones.
